name: chandra_flames_catalyst_minus_two_recasts_a_red_instant_and_exiles_it
notes: Printed: '[-2]: You may cast target red instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.' Through the menu the -2 targets Shock in your graveyard (the one legal target, so not asked); as it resolves Shock is cast (CR 608.2g), its target chosen as it is cast (the opponent's Bear) and its mana cost paid with the {R} in the pool (the effect-cast lane pays from the pool only: a Mountain would not do, see the mapper's report). It is a cast: Spellgorger Weird ('Whenever you cast a noncreature spell') gets a +1/+1 counter. Shock kills the Bear and is exiled instead of going to the graveyard (CR 614.1a). Loyalty 5 -> 3.
